# Contributing to Excel Masters 📊

Welcome to the **Excel Masters** open-source community! We build and maintain interactive spreadsheet tools, learning resources, and community automation services.

## How to Contribute

1. **Reporting Bugs**: Check the existing issues first. If not found, use our [Bug Report Template](https://github.com/ExcelMasters-in/.github/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
2. **Proposing Features**: Share your ideas using the [Feature Request Template](https://github.com/ExcelMasters-in/.github/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
3. **Pull Requests**:
   - Fork or branch off `main`.
   - Make clean, focused commits.
   - Open a pull request using the provided template.
   - Our automated CI will run integrity tests on your changes.

## Community & Discussions

Join our active [Discord Community](https://discord.gg/7vaHhewmtJ) or visit our [Official Web Portal](https://www.excelmasters.in/) for learning resources and real-time chat.
